0022600138.text: The Milwaukee Bucks, 0-3 and 5th in the Central, 3 games back, host the 3-0 Houston Rockets, who lead the Southwest and are 3rd in the West, while Milwaukee is on a three-game losing streak and sits 13th in the East. Houston is missing Marcus Smart (out, forearm strain) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and no Bucks players are listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 119-113 in Houston on April 1, 2026.
